messages:
Maya Singh: FYI — CorpNet (Dana) asked for an auth + identity pack for the POC: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain verification requirements, and the security questionnaire answers. They want a POC runbook + basic pricing estimate by EOD Friday.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks Maya. Do we have expected number of users and whether they want hosted vs dedicated for performance/SLA? That affects pricing.
Dana Wu: ~3k users total, 400 active daily. For POC they want hosted but need option to move to dedicated if latency spikes. Also: SCIM bulk sync 1k users/min — can you confirm throttling behaviour?
Priya Patel: @Dana we can do hosted for POC and provide a dedicated sizing fallback. Quick POC plan:
- Day 0: exchange SAML metadata + SCIM service account
- Day 1: test SSO login flows (IdP-initiated & SP-initiated)
- Day 2: run SCIM delta sync (10k users total, 1k/min bursts)
- Day 3: RBAC demo + domain proofing
- Acceptance: successful SSO + SCIM sync without 5xx, RBAC roles mapped, perf <200ms p90 on hosted
Priya Patel: SCIM mapping sample (attribute names they asked for):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "user@example.com",
  "name": { "givenName": "Dana", "familyName": "Wu" },
  "emails": [{ "value": "user@example.com", "primary": true }],
  "groups": ["engineering", "admin"]
}
```
Priya Patel: For bulk rate we support configurable rate limits; default hosted SCIM throttle = 500 reqs/min, can request burst increase to 1k/min for POC window. We'll enable delta pagination and backoff headers.
Jon Reyes: From security side: we'll supply completed questionnaire sections: SAML metadata endpoint + fingerprint, TLS 1.2+, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration for keys, audit log retention options (30/90/365 days). For domain controls we require DNS TXT ownership or email verification per tenant.
Priya Patel: SAML example (IdP metadata URL) + quick test command for SP metadata fetch:
```
curl -o idp.xml "https://idp.corpnet.com/metadata"
# then upload to Console -> Auth -> SAML
```
Priya Patel: Note: SP-initiated flows require ACS URL config on their IdP; we'll provide ACS and EntityID values once POC env is ready.
Liam O'Connor: Pricing note: hosted POC cost for 3k users (light usage) ~ $X/month (usage-based). Dedicated sizing (if they want 99% p95 SLA) would be monthly reserved GPU pool starting ~ $Y/month — I can draft a two-column quote: POC hosted vs Dedicated reserved capacity.
Dana Wu: For RBAC we need custom role names + delegated admins per domain. Can Redwood map external groups -> internal roles automatically during SCIM import?
Priya Patel: Yes — mapping rules supported. Example mapping rule:
```
SCIM group "corpnet:admins" -> Redwood role "admin"
SCIM group "corpnet:devs" -> Redwood role "developer"
```
We can also sync group membership to multi-tenant RBAC namespaces for domain isolation.
DeployBot: POC environment created: env-id=poce-1794512340, SAML endpoints assigned, SCIM endpoint active.
Jon Reyes: One security caveat: if they enable SCIM push from Okta/Azure, we recommend a scoped service account and IP allowlist. We'll add that to the questionnaire answers.
Maya Singh: Perfect. Next steps for this thread:
1) @Priya: finalize POC runbook & attach SAML/SCIM examples in doc (by tomorrow)
2) @Liam: draft hosted vs dedicated quote and call out burst pricing (by EOD Thu)
3) @Jon: populate security questionnaire answers and domain proofing steps
4) @Dana: confirm SCIM burst window and IdP contact for metadata
I'll own the customer sync meeting when we have the docs. :thumbsup:
